title: Using Word Embeddings Based on Psychological Studies of Fairness to Develop a Fairness Metric for Texts

bias_targets.methodology: Constructing a multi-dimensional fairness perception vector by performing linear arithmetic (addition and subtraction) on Universal Sentence Encoder (USE) embeddings of sentences representing psychological factors (responsibility, emotion, benefit, consequence), and calculating cosine similarity against a dataset of sentences describing fair and unfair acts.
